entities.summary: Constantin Argetoianu was a Romanian politician, one of the best-known personalities of interwar Greater Romania, who served as the Prime Minister between 28 September and 23 November 1939. His memoirs, Memorii. Pentru cei de mâine. Amintiri din vremea celor de ieri — a cross section of Romanian society, were made known for the sharp critique of several major figures in Romanian politics.
